git add internal/cli/viz.go && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
fix(viz): validate ENTIRE_WEB_BASE_URL scheme; cap /api/search limit

Copilot round-6 findings:

- vizWebBase used the env override verbatim; a javascript:/data: scheme
  would flow into every generated link. Only absolute http(s) URLs with a
  host may override the default base now.
- /api/search accepted an unbounded ?limit; it is now capped at
  vizSearchMaxHits (500) — hits render in the rail/palette, so anything
  beyond a few hundred per source is never useful.
